categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Represents resolution of the fine case through prompt payment. Advances softgoals such as 'Maximize timely fine revenue' and helps 'Minimize administrative & enforcement cost', evaluated against indicator 'Time to fine dispatch (days)' and 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 12 as observed in frequent variants such as V0002 and V0007.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Represents resolution of the fine case through delayed or subsequent payment after penalties or enforcement steps. Helps maximize timely fine revenue.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 13 as observed in variants like V0004, V0005, and V0006 where payments happen after notifications and penalties.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Represents resolution through administrative appeal processes addressed to the Prefecture. Preserves offender due-process rights while potentially impacting enforcement costs and revenue.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 14, evidenced by traces containing date inserts and appeals directed to the Prefecture such as V0008.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Represents resolution through judicial appeals directed to a judge, strongly advancing offender due-process rights while increasing costs.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 19, supported by variants demonstrating judicial appeals like V0140 and V0176.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Represents resolution through coercive credit collection steps when other paths fail. Helps fine revenue but incurs enforcement costs.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative 20, widely observed in frequent variants ending in credit collection such as V0001 and V0009.
